'''Athelis Kallis ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A rare non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Pureblood in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], she joined the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] and spent years researching the culture of [[Voss]]. In [[3640 BBY]] she was approached by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] looking for the information on the [[Forbidden Ritual]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Athelis Kallis appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss. If the male Inquisitor attempts to flirt with her, she will reveal that she is happily [[Marriage/Legends|married]].
